name: Lastovo
description: A closed military island until 1989, so it missed thirty years of tourism entirely. Forty-six islands and islets in the group, one proper village of stone houses with chimneys built like small towers, and some of the darkest night sky in the Adriatic.
getting: Ferry from Split via Hvar and Korčula — four and a half hours, once or twice a day. Bring what you need; the shops are small and the last boat back is early.
